name: Calendar Table
description: Receives tab-separated calendar data from SAC scripting and renders it as a styled table with CSV download.

tableData.description: Tab-separated calendar data string — set via setTableData() from SAC scripting.

setTableData.description: Pass tab-separated calendar data from SAC scripting to render as a table. First row must be the header. Columns separated by tab (\t), rows by newline (\n).

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Tab-separated string — first row is the header row.

clearTable.description: Clears all table data and resets the widget to its empty state.

onDataLoaded.description: Fired after setTableData() has parsed and rendered the table.
